preconditions.description: The input string s must be non-empty.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s must consist only of Latin letters and digits.
The length of the input string s must not exceed 5·10^6.

postconditions.description: The output must be the sum of the palindrome degrees of all prefixes of the input string s.
